manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and its velocity-time line move together. At the top v = 0 but the slope stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left scene shows a ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. The right scene plots velocity against time with the slope -g. Force is mass times gravity.
